records.title: MARLIN: De Novo Molecular Structure Elucidation from Tandem Mass Spectra without a Ground-Truth Formula
records.reason: MARLIN is a molecular-structure generation/application model; the abstract does not present inference efficiency or serving evidence.

records.title: FAST: A Holistic Framework for Optimizing Memory-I/O, Computation, and Sampling in Temporal GNN Training
records.reason: FAST targets temporal graph neural network training and its sampling/I/O/computation pipeline, outside LLM inference/serving scope.

records.title: Steering Optimisation Trajectories in Diffusion Representation Learning
records.reason: The work studies optimization trajectories in diffusion representation learning, not language-model inference or serving.

records.title: ResonatorLM: Causal Resonant Field Mixing for Efficient Long-Context Language Modeling
records.reason: Despite a potentially relevant long-context architecture, the primary evidence is a small custom-scale setup and does not establish competitive inference quality or efficiency at practical language-model sizes; resolving that gap requires a substantial scale-up study.

records.title: ReflectWorld-MM: An Entity-Oriented Multimodal Memory System for Open-Ended Video Streams
records.reason: The bounded-memory design is adjacent to efficient multimodal inference, but its primary evaluation does not demonstrate an inference/serving efficiency outcome; fit remains weak until compute/token/latency costs are measured.
